scope: Exploratory external-benchmark pilot, not a full 300-task leaderboard submission or a claim of general superiority

pre_inference_amendments.reason: pre-inference exclusion after non-discriminating official empty control; first eligible unused candidate in preregistered metadata rank

harness.reason: Compatible legacy Lite dataset schema; explicit versioned comparison, not current-main equivalence
harness.echo_validity_gate: all required test identities observed with PASSED or XFAIL; missing/skip/error/timeout never certifies a test; zero F2P rejected at preflight

I2_allocation.selector_sees: public evidence and patches only; never final reports

context.preflight: exact llama.cpp tokenizer on full formatted prompt; evict/re-page before reservation; no silent truncation
context.ast: optional indexed navigation; original source remains authority; no semantic pruning
context.file_view_accounting: Exception to generic tool observation cap: conservative UTF-8 JSON bytes (or injected tokenizer); exact full prompt must still fit 3200 model tokens before generation; no partial source lines.

visibility.final_release_after: all phases and submissions frozen; no final-oracle feedback to any later episode

acceptance.online: PUBLIC_CHECKS_PASSED is a scoped observation, never RESOLVED
acceptance.unknown: Missing artifacts, invalid parsing or unobserved tests cannot certify success. Normal budget exhaustion freezes the retained candidate; its final score is still evaluated under the common rule.
acceptance.final_retry: at most one repeat of identical bytes for independently classified infrastructure failure; record both; no repair or model rerun

stopping.critic_exhaustion: freeze the best existing candidate using public evidence; final evaluation still runs
stopping.refutation: freeze critic while repairing; max two repairs for that refutation; then fixed stop/resume rule
stopping.episode_limit: freeze last authorized retained candidate or empty diff, count all spent resources
stopping.global_limit: finish current bounded operation; mark remaining pre-registered rows not_started and report incomplete campaign
stopping.resume: only with identical frozen lock and no access to final outcomes

memory.publication: public replay evidence only; never final official score
memory.ast_similarity: retrieval hint only; no semantic veto
memory.acquisition: charge failed donors, publication, lookup and invalidation
memory.curriculum: same donor history once per chain; shared receiver updates only from public observations; empty controls reset
memory.negative_transfer: record unsupported/irrelevant/stale retrieval and regressions; separate sham/fixed-library confirmation still required

analysis.primary_denominator: all 24 registered issues per arm; errors and unfinished rows count as not resolved and are shown separately
analysis.paired: wins/losses/ties by issue; do not treat four arms or seeds as independent issues
analysis.confirmatory: future power analysis; repo-aware uncertainty and Holm correction of predeclared contrasts
analysis.regressions_blocked_denominator: unique candidate snapshots with observed public regression under the common diagnostic suite
analysis.cost_per_resolved: cost of every assigned issue including failures divided by resolved; null if zero
analysis.population_claim: panel rate only; no automatic extrapolation to 300
analysis.plot_registration: Measured exports require independent contract and sample bytes; match registered IDs, repos, seeds and memory chains.

gpu_budget.requested_2_to_3_hours: unverified; size using pilot prompt/decode throughput plus local test latency and idle GPU time

ready_to_run_requires: per-instance public rootfs and official image digests
empty/gold environment controls in curator only
sealed SWE-RUN-LOCK valid and all expected instance IDs present
